reports.title: Guide
reports.query:
### Introduction

#### What this report tool is

This is the StudyBuilder - Activity Metadata Check Report, the purpose of this report is to expose inconsistencies such as:
  - gaps in data (missing activity items)
  - invalid/missing groupings.

### Search Functions

This report includs two different searching methods - top-down, and bottom-up. The former allows you to drill down into the activity items (viewable in the **Missing Activity Items** tab), the latter is used to verify activities have the correct items grouped to them (viewable in the **Grouping Check** tab).

reports.title: List of Missing Mandatory Items for Instances
reports.query: After using the top-down search page, you will be able to view the results on the Missing Activity Items page. This page returns a list of information about the activity items attached to your selected classes/subclasses and groups/subgroups. The idea is to identify gaps in the table to more easily modify the database.

reports.title: Grouping Check
reports.query: After using the bottom-up search page, you will be able to view the results on the Grouping Check page. This page gives a comprehensive overview of different activity groupings, as well as which groupings need updating/removing due to database inconsistency.

reports.title: Missing Grouping
reports.query: This page is a consistency check to ensure all latest Activity instances follow the correct conditions. All 4 values should be the same, otherwise there is an inconsistency in the data.

reports.query:
// Skip entirely if parameter is empty
WITH $neodash_activity AS actName
WHERE actName <> ''

// Anchor on the specific ActivityValue first (uses index)
MATCH (act:ActivityValue {name: actName})

// Core traversal from anchor
MATCH (act)-[:HAS_GROUPING]->(g:ActivityGrouping)
      -[:HAS_SELECTED_SUBGROUP]->(asgrp:ActivitySubGroupValue),
      (g)-[:HAS_SELECTED_GROUP]->(agrp:ActivityGroupValue),
      (g)<-[:HAS_ACTIVITY]-(aigv:ActivityInstanceGroupingValue)
         <-[:LATEST]-(:ActivityInstanceGroupingRoot)
         <-[:HAS_GROUPING_ROOT]-(:ActivityInstanceRoot)
         -[:LATEST]->(ai:ActivityInstanceValue)
         -[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->(aitm1:ActivityItem)

MATCH (ai)-[:ACTIVITY_INSTANCE_CLASS]->(aicr:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)
         -[:LATEST]->(aic:ActivityInstanceClassValue)

// Require ActivityItemClass — was MATCH so keep as MATCH
MATCH (aitmc1r:ActivityItemClassRoot)-[:HAS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]->(aitm1),
      (aitmc1r)-[:LATEST]->(aitmc1:ActivityItemClassValue)

// Require DataType — was MATCH so keep as MATCH
MATCH (aitmc1)-[:HAS_DATA_TYPE]->(:CTTermContext)
      -[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->(dtype_r:CTTermRoot)
      -[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTTermNameRoot)
      -[:LATEST]->(dtype_val)

// Optional parent class traversals
OPTIONAL MATCH (aicr)-[:PARENT_CLASS]->(aicrp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(aicp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aicrp)-[:PARENT_CLASS]->(aicrpp:ActivityInstanceClassRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(aicpp:ActivityInstanceClassValue)

// Optional item class membership checks
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicr)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrp)
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1r)<-[:HAS_ITEM_CLASS]-(aicrpp)

// Optional Role
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitmc1)-[:HAS_ROLE]->(:CTTermContext)
               -[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->(role_r:CTTermRoot)
               -[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTTermNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(role_val)

// Optional CT Terms
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitm1)-[:HAS_CT_TERM]->(ct_context:CTTermContext)
               -[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->(ct2cd:CTTermRoot)
               -[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTTermNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(ct2_sponsor),
               (ct2cd)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTTermAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(ct2_cdisc),
               (ct2cd)<-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]-(:CTCodelistTerm)
               <-[:HAS_TERM]-(clr:CTCodelistRoot)
               <-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]-(ct_context),
               (ct2cd)<-[:CONTAINS_TERM]-(:Library)

// Optional codelist attributes
OPTIONAL MATCH (clr)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(clatt:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (clr)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_sponsor)

// Optional unit dimension on context
OPTIONAL MATCH (ct_context)<-[:HAS_CT_DIMENSION]-(pos_units_in_dim:UnitDefinitionValue)

// Optional unit definition
OPTIONAL MATCH (aitm1)-[:HAS_UNIT_DEFINITION]->(:UnitDefinitionRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(unit_term:UnitDefinitionValue)
               -[:HAS_CT_DIMENSION]->(:CTTermContext)
               -[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->(cl_unit_root:CTCodelistRoot)
               -[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_unit_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cl_unit_root)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_unit_sponsor)

// Resolve CT term and codelist values once
WITH
  agrp.name                                     AS ActivityGroup,
  asgrp.name                                    AS ActivitySubGroup,
  act.name                                      AS Activity,
  aitmc1.name                                   AS ActivityItemClass,
  role_val.name                                 AS Role,
  dtype_val.name                                AS DataType,
  // Resolve CT2 with priority: pos_units_in_dim > unit_term > merged ct term
  CASE
    WHEN pos_units_in_dim IS NOT NULL THEN pos_units_in_dim.name
    WHEN unit_term        IS NOT NULL THEN unit_term.name
    WHEN ct2cd            IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.merge(properties(ct2_cdisc), properties(ct2_sponsor)).name
    ELSE null
  END AS term,
  // Resolve codelist with priority: clr > cl_unit_root
  CASE
    WHEN clr         IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.merge(properties(cl_cdisc), properties(cl_sponsor)).name
    WHEN cl_unit_root IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.map.merge(properties(cl_unit_cdisc), properties(cl_unit_sponsor)).preferred_term
    ELSE null
  END AS CodeList

// Aggregate per Activity + ActivityItemClass combination
WITH
  Activity,
  ActivityItemClass,
  Role,
  DataType,
  CodeList,
  collect(DISTINCT ActivityGroup)    AS ActivityGroups,
  collect(DISTINCT ActivitySubGroup) AS ActivitySubGroups,
  collect(DISTINCT term)             AS Terms

RETURN
  ActivityGroups    AS `Activity Group`,
  ActivitySubGroups AS `Activity Subgroup`,
  Activity,
  ActivityItemClass AS `Activity Item Class`,
  Terms,
  CodeList          AS `Code List`,
  Role,
  DataType          AS `Data Type`

OPTIONAL MATCH (role_r)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTTermNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(role_val)

// 10. Second WITH DISTINCT before expensive CT term lookups
WITH DISTINCT
  agrp, asgrp, ai, aitm1, aicr, aic,
  aitmc1r, aitmc1, aicp,
  dtype_val, role_val

// 11. Optional CT Terms

OPTIONAL MATCH (ct_context)-[:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]->(ct2cd:CTTermRoot)

               -[:LATEST]->(ct2_sponsor)

               -[:LATEST]->(ct2_cdisc)

OPTIONAL MATCH (clr)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_cdisc:CTCodelistAttributesValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (clr)-[:HAS_NAME_ROOT]->(:CTCodelistNameRoot)
               -[:LATEST]->(cl_sponsor)

// 15. Optional unit codelist
OPTIONAL MATCH (unit_term)-[:HAS_CT_DIMENSION]->(ct_context2)
OPTIONAL MATCH (ct_context2)-[:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->(cl_unit_root:CTCodelistRoot)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cl_unit_root)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]-(:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)

               -[:LATEST]->(cl_unit_sponsor)

  aic.name AS Class,
  agrp.name AS ActivityGroup,
  asgrp.name AS ActivitySubGroup,
  ai.name AS Instance,
  ai.adam_param_code AS ADAM_CODE,

    cl_cdisc.name,
    cl_unit_sponsor.preferred_term,
    cl_unit_cdisc.name
  ) AS `Code List`

// 17. Final aggregation
RETURN DISTINCT
  Class,
  Instance,
  ADAM_CODE,
  `Activity Item Class`,
  apoc.convert.toSet(collect(terms)) AS Term,
  `Code List`,
  Role,
  `Data Type`
